# A Canadian company repays a US dollar loan with US dollars it bought, and
# writes one repayment wholly in US dollars.
#
# Repaying the loan disposes of two things at once: the dollars leave the bank,
# drawing its cost basis down, and the debt they pay off goes, drawing the loan's
# cost basis down. Where those two cost different amounts a unit, the difference
# is realized, and a split has to say what it is — `$residual$` in the book's own
# currency. A transaction written wholly in US dollars has no split in Canadian
# dollars to state it, so it is refused.
#
# What happens:
#
# - 2030-01-02  10,000.00 CAD of opening capital.
# - 2030-01-05  3,000.00 USD bought at 1.30.
# - 2030-02-01  1,500.00 USD borrowed at 1.35, stated in Canadian dollars, so
#               the dollars in the bank and the debt both cost 2,025.00 CAD.
# - 2030-06-30  the loan repaid with 1,500.00 USD out of the dollars bought at
#               1.30, written wholly in US dollars. The debt cost 2,025.00 and
#               the dollars that pay it cost 1,950.00, so 75.00 is realized and
#               nothing in the transaction can say so. Refused.
# - 2030-07-02  the same repayment written in Canadian dollars, with
#               `Income:FX Gain` taking the 75.00 as `$residual$`. Imported.
# - 2030-08-01  500.00 USD borrowed at 1.30, stated in Canadian dollars.
# - 2030-09-01  that loan repaid with 500.00 USD bought at 1.30, written wholly
#               in US dollars. Both sides cost 1.30, so nothing is realized and
#               there is nothing to state. Imported.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_repayment_stating_no_canadian_figure_is_refused_where_it_realizes_a_difference.py.
2030-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2030-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 10000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -10000.00 CAD

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 3000.00 USD
		guid: "d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d40001"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "3900.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -3900.00 CAD

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 1500.00 USD
		guid: "d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d40002"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "2025.00"
	Liabilities:USD Loan -1500.00 USD
		guid: "d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d40003"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "-2025.00"

2030-06-30 * "Repay the loan, written wholly in US dollars"

		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "2025.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d40003"

		value: "-1950.00"

	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
